Name: Quest Services
Author: Ice3ICE3
Description:
[left][b][size=5][color=#2E8B57]Quest Services[/color][/size][/b][/left]

A quality-of-life [b]SMAPI mod[/b] for [b]Stardew Valley[/b] that brings practical paid services to the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b].


Tired of time pressure from daily quests? This mod gives you lore-friendly ways to handle them without altering quest rewards, content, or game balance.


[left][b][size=4][color=#2E8B57]Features[/color][/size][/b][/left]

[b][color=#FF8C00]Quest Completion[/color][/b]
Pay the Guild to advance supported daily Help Wanted quests — Fishing, Resource Collection, Monster Slaying, and Social/Greeting. 
Most quests are brought to the turn-in stage. 
Also supports [b]Pelican Town Special Orders[/b] and [b]Qi Special Orders[/b] (can be toggled separately).


[b][color=#FF8C00]Quest Rescheduling[/color][/b]
Extend the deadline of your active daily quests. 
Original quest target, type, and reward remain completely unchanged. 
Available extensions: [b]1 day (100g)[/b] • [b]5 days (500g)[/b] • [b]10 days (1000g)[/b]


[b][color=#FF8C00]Quest Supplies[/color][/b]
Buy the exact items required by your current daily quests directly from the Guild. 
Prices are fixed at [b]2× normal value[/b].


Services are intelligently filtered — only usable options will appear in the menu.


[left][b][size=4][color=#2E8B57]Configuration[/color][/size][/b][/left]

Compatible with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]. 
Easily enable or disable any feature:
Quest Completion • Quest Rescheduling • Quest Supplies • Pelican Town Special Orders • Qi Special Orders


All features are enabled by default. Economy values are intentionally fixed to maintain balance.


[left][b][size=4][color=#2E8B57]Installation[/color][/size][/b][/left]

Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b]. 
Download and install [b]Quest Services[/b] via Nexus Mods. 
(Optional but recommended) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for easy configuration.


Designed with clean menu filtering and natural integration into the game world.


Enjoy more flexibility with Stardew Valley’s time-sensitive quests while preserving the original experience!
